sn.c: Orchestra row A can be a little close to the stage for easy viewing.
sn.sh: Row A can be a little close

sn.c: The Balcony has the tightest legroom in the theater, especially for taller people.
The Mezzanine overhang only becomes obvious at Orchestra row R and does not affect views of the stage too much.
sn.sh: Overhang becomes obvious at row R

sn.c: The Hudson Theatre Orchestra has better than average legroom, having been refurbished prior to its 2017 re-opening.
Balcony seats sit further back but usually still give a solid view of the stage.

vs.sum: A beautifully restored 1903 gem — one of the most gorgeous small theaters on Broadway. The 2017 renovation delivered some of the widest and most comfortable seats in the Theater District, with excellent sightlines from the intimate 970-seat house.

acc.note: Elevator to Dress Circle. No elevator to Balcony. Assisted listening devices at coat check.
